answer_1.quote: Automated Audio Captioning (AAC) is a task that generates natural language descriptions of audio content...
answer_1.outputs: natural language captions describing audio content

answer_2.quote: We use various metrics, including BLEU(BL-1-4), ROUGE-L(RG-L), METEOR(ME), CIDEr(CD), SPICE(SP), SPIDEr(SD), SPIDEr-FL(SD-F), Sentence-BERT(SB), and FENSE(FS) to evaluate model performance.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 18 evaluators... assigned a score between 1 and 5 based on the Mean Opinion Score (MOS) method.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were provided with audio samples and asked to assign a MOS score (1‑5) reflecting how accurately each caption described the audio.
